MATCH (p:Player)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document), (p)-[:PlaysFor {tenure: 'latest'}]->(t:Team)-[:ExtractedFrom]->(:Document)
WHERE (CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) < 0 AND CAST(p.mvp_awards AS INT64) <= 0)
   OR (
        (
          CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) > 1948
          OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1948 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) > 10)
          OR (CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 1) AS INT64) = 1948 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 2) AS INT64) = 10 AND CAST(split_part(p.birth_date, '/', 3) AS INT64) > 14)
        )
        AND CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64) >= 0
      )
WITH t, MIN(CAST(p.fiba_world_cup AS INT64)) AS lowest_titles
RETURN t.team_name AS col1, lowest_titles AS col2
